import sys
import subprocess

# My own tools will be used to wrap and log the execution of the provided script.
sys.path.append('storage/logos')
from research_utils import Experiment

script_to_run = 'storage/shared/kairos_quickstarts/hello_storage_import.py'

with Experiment(title=f"Execution of {script_to_run}") as exp:
    exp._log(f"Attempting to execute script provided by Kairos I.", indent=2)
    
    # Use subprocess to run the target Python script.
    result = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, script_to_run],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True
    )
    
    exp._log("--- Script STDOUT ---", indent=4)
    exp._log(result.stdout, indent=6)
    exp._log("--- Script STDERR ---", indent=4)
    exp._log(result.stderr, indent=6)
    
    if result.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Script failed with return code {result.returncode}.")
